anomalies.observed: C33 is annotated with value "10u" (10 µF), but its library part, footprint, PN (GRM188R72A103KA01J), and description all identify a 10 nF / 10000 pF 100 V 0603 X7R Murata capacitor. The value field and the physical part disagree.
anomalies.expected: The value should match the part being placed, e.g. 10n for the 0603 10 nF X7R part, or the footprint and PN should be changed to a 10 µF part if that was intended.
anomalies.impact: The +3V3 decoupling value is ambiguous between a 10 nF and a 10 µF part on the same 0603 footprint, so the built board may receive a different capacitor than the one the designer intended. The functional impact is probably small.

anomalies.observed: R5 (10 kΩ) is a pull-up from the main-pump MOSFET gate net /G_PUMP to +3V3, not a pull-down to GND. The sister ATO channel uses R12 (10 kΩ) as a pull-down from /G_ATO to GND, so the two gate networks are inconsistent.
anomalies.expected: A low-side N-MOSFET gate should be pulled down to GND so the pump is off by default, e.g. as the ATO channel does with R12. Pulling the gate to +3V3 turns IRLR2905 T2 on whenever the ESP32 pin floats or is in reset.
anomalies.impact: The main circulation pump may energise at boot or during any GPIO float or reset, since its gate is held high. The spec does not document this pull-up, so it may be an unintended net change.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows a value/footprint mismatch on C33 and a pump-gate pull-up to +3V3 (R5) that is inconsistent with the ATO channel's pull-down. Both are low-to-moderate confidence, since the reference design is itself messy and the spec does not cover these parts.
